entities.name: Golden Argosy
entities.description: Legendary Keldon longship atop the Keldon Necropolis that ferries warriors to crucial battles.

entities.name: Kradak
entities.description: First Keldon Doyen who stole the ship from Parma.

entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: Where the Golden Argosy was perched.

entities.name: Keldon Twilight
entities.description: Prophesied event when the ship would carry risen champions.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Place of the crucial battle of the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: Legendary warrior who rode the Argosy in the second invasion.

entities.name: Battle of the Mana Rig
entities.description: Battle the Argosy took part in.

events.summary: Kradak steals the Golden Argosy from Parma and brings it to the Keldon Necropolis.
events.quote: was stolen by the first Keldon Doyen, Kradak

events.summary: At the Keldon Twilight the Argosy rescues living Keldon warriors and Skyshroud elves and carries them to Urborg.
events.quote: Golden Argosy instead rescued the living Keldon warriors from the freezing waters

events.summary: The Argosy reappears for a second twilight and joins the Battle of the Mana Rig.
events.quote: the Golden Argosy reappeared with warriors

relations.note: He stole it and sailed the world on it.
relations.quote: According to legend, Kradak sailed around the world on the ship
